stem:
A lifeguard earns $320 per week for working 40 hours plus $12 per hour worked over 40 hours. A lifeguard can work a maximum of 60 hours per week.

Which graph best represents the lifeguard’s weekly earnings in dollars for working h hours over 40?

options.label: F
options.text: (graph labeled F showing weekly earnings from 0 to about 480 dollars when h is about 20)

options.label: H
options.text: (graph labeled H showing weekly earnings from 0 to about 320 dollars when h is about 30)

options.label: G
options.text: (graph labeled G showing weekly earnings from 0 to about 560 dollars when h is about 20)

options.label: J
options.text: (graph labeled J showing weekly earnings from 0 to about 480 dollars when h is about 40)

visual_elements: Graph F: Weekly Earnings w vs Number of Hours h Worked over 40, w-axis shows from 100 to 600, h-axis from 0 to 25, point at about (20,480)
Graph H: Weekly Earnings w vs Number of Hours h Worked over 40, w-axis shows 0 to 600, h-axis from 0 to 50, point at about (30,320)
Graph G: Weekly Earnings w vs Number of Hours h Worked over 40, w-axis shows 100 to 600, h-axis from 0 to 25, point at about (20,560)
Graph J: Weekly Earnings w vs Number of Hours h Worked over 40, w-axis shows 0 to 600, h-axis from 0 to 50, point at about (40,480)
notes: Graphs interpreted visually with reference points as approximate. Exact coordinates on graphs not given but estimated.
